domain: Shares the template's general shape (an object with an affine-matrix-adjacent sub-object at offset 16, a call into an affine/rotation helper, and bit-field writes into that sub-object) but implements a state-machine effect driver: a mode byte (object offset5) selects one of two 32-entry tables (by a wrapping counter at offset12, modes 9/10) or one of two 8-entry tables (by a saturating counter, modes 11/12, which stop advancing past index 7), producing a 16-bit 'value' that defaults to 256 (a sentinel meaning 'no active effect') when the mode doesn't match or a saturating counter has already maxed out.
behavior: value defaults to 256 (0x100); modes 9/10 read+advance a wrapping (mod 32) counter into one of two 32-entry halfword tables, mode 10 additionally halving the looked-up value; modes 11/12 do the same against two different 8-entry tables (offset +32 from the table base, stride 4) but only while the counter is <=7, otherwise leaving value at the 256 default
if value==256: clears specific bits in the sub-object's offset7 and offset5 byte fields, then falls through to a shared tail that copies obj->field6/field8 into the sub-object's field6/field4

otherwise: packs the value into a stack-resident bitfield structure, calls Func_08003d28 on it, masks the low 5 bits of the result into the sub-object's offset7 byte (bit 1 upward), and then branches on whether value exceeds 256: the >256 case sets two extra sub-object bits, computes field6 from obj->field6 minus 8, and field4 from obj->field8+248, returning early; the <=256-but-not-equal case instead sets a single different bit pattern and falls into the same field6/field4 tail as the value==256 case

bounded_search.reason: One complete-behavior candidate was written directly from the raw assembly and scored (228 vs 320 bytes, 92 bytes short, 187 wrong instructions). The stack-resident bit-packing block feeding Func_08003d28 (which the disassembly builds via three separate AND/OR/shift operations against a 12-byte stack buffer, reusing pool masks 0xffff0000/0x0000ffff/0x0000fff8/0xfffffe00) was approximated with a single scalar expression rather than reconstructing the actual struct/bitfield layout that produces that exact instruction sequence, which accounts for most of the size gap.

remaining: This owner is markedly more involved than the family's typical member (320 bytes, an inlined affine-matrix-style bit-packing block plus a 4-way table-driven state machine) and needs a dedicated pass to recover the actual stack struct passed to Func_08003d28 -- almost certainly the same kind of 3-halfword 'Effect'-like structure the template builds for its own AffineMatrix_BuildForEffect call, but packed and masked differently here. The table-driven mode dispatch (modes 9-12, wrapping vs saturating counters, the two table shapes) is corroborated directly against the assembly and is higher-confidence than the bit-packing block.
notes: Struct field names (SubObject.field4/field5/field6/field7, Object.field8) are placeholder offsets read directly off this owner's own assembly; the correspondence to the template's Object/Effect struct is only structural (same offset16 sub-object idea), not verified field-for-field.
